2608.16622.title: HarmTrace: Anchor-Calibrated Decoupled Optimization for Fine-Grained Target Identification in Harmful Memes
2608.16622.paper_summary: Multimodal harmful meme detection is typically formulated as image--text harmfulness classification. A model may correctly predict harmfulness while misidentifying the attacked target or its supporting evidence. We therefore extend harmful meme detection with fine-grained target identification, asking what type of target is attacked, who is targeted, and where the target appears in the meme. The model predicts harmfulness for every meme and, for harmful memes, outputs the target category, target entity, textual mention, and visual region. To support this task, we introduce Meme3W, which unifies multiple public harmful meme datasets and provides human-verified annotations for harmful instances. We further introduce Joint Record Accuracy (JRA), a strict record-level metric requiring the harmfulness label and all target-identification fields to be jointly correct. Experiments with representative multimodal large language models reveal a substantial gap between harmfulness accuracy and JRA. To narrow this gap, we propose HarmTrace, an anchor-calibrated decoupled optimization framework. HarmTrace strengthens target-entity supervision through entity-aware supervised fine-tuning. It then applies Conditional Target-identification Policy Optimization (CTPO) to decouple harmfulness and target-identification advantages, restricting target-identification optimization to label-correct responses for harmful examples. CTPO uses a Virtual Positive Anchor (VPA) as a fully correct reference for target-identification advantage normalization. HarmTrace improves both JRA and harmfulness accuracy across the evaluated backbones, with JRA on the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone increasing from 17.58\% to 52.51\%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-Harmful-Memes.
2608.16622.paper_summary_zh: 多模態有害迷因檢測通常被表述為圖像--文本有害性分類。模型可能正確預測有害性，但錯誤識別了被攻擊的目標或其支持證據。因此，我們擴展了有害迷因檢測，進行細緻的目標識別，詢問攻擊的是哪種類型的目標、誰是被針對的對象，以及目標在迷因中出現的位置。模型對每個迷因預測有害性，並對於有害迷因，輸出目標類別、目標實體、文本提及和視覺區域。為了支持這項任務，我們引入了Meme3W，它統一了多個公共有害迷因數據集，並提供了經過人工驗證的有害實例註釋。我們進一步引入了聯合記錄準確率（JRA），這是一種嚴格的記錄級指標，要求有害性標籤和所有目標識別字段必須共同正確。與具有代表性的多模態大型語言模型的實驗顯示，對有害性準確率和JRA之間存在顯著差距。為了縮小這一差距，我們提出了HarmTrace，一種錨點校準的解耦優化框架。HarmTrace通過實體感知的監督微調來加強目標實體的監督。然後，它應用條件目標識別策略優化（CTPO）來解耦有害性和目標識別的優勢，將目標識別優化限制於對有害示例的標籤正確響應。CTPO使用虛擬正錨（VPA）作為目標識別優勢標準化的完全正確參考。HarmTrace在評估的基礎上提高了JRA和有害性準確率，其中在Qwen3-VL-8B基礎上的JRA從17.58\%提高到52.51\%。我們的代碼已公開可用於 https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-Harmful-Memes。
